title: doctor passes a manifest that records no files as 0 vendored files intact, and upgrade then overwrites an edit
body:
## Problem

0127 named three swallowed statuses in `lib/cmd/doctor` as unreachable (then :244, :383, :420). Read again at 2ce9411, two kinds are unreachable as claimed -- a `grep -c` over a pipe cannot exit 2, and the catalogue accessors cannot miss a row their names came from -- and a fourth site of the second kind has since been added (`:193`, `builtin_option_suffix ... || true`). One status IS reachable, and it is a false green: `:358` passes `manifest: N vendored files intact` with `grep -c . || true`, so a manifest that has lost its entries passes with N = 0.

## Measured at 2ce9411 (0152 v1 on 953d040; cc's evidence pass)

A manifest cut to its `#` header in a fresh install: `doctor` prints `ok manifest: 0 vendored files intact`, lists all 73 files under `bin/.devbin/lib` as unowned with the advice to delete them, and ends `12 checks, 0 failed`, rc 0. Over the same manifest, with `lib/cmd/version` edited, `upgrade --from <devbin>` prints `updated bin/.devbin/lib/cmd/version` at rc 0 and the edit is gone; with an intact manifest the control prints `skipped ... edited in place`. That is 0146's hazard, reached through a manifest that exists and records nothing.

## Fix

1. A manifest with no entries FAILS doctor by name -- it records no files, so no vendored file can be checked -- and the unowned-file check is skipped there, as it is for a missing or unreadable manifest.
2. Counting lines goes through one pure `nonempty_lines` in `lib/helpers` (a read loop ending in `return 0`), which replaces both `grep -c . || true` counts in doctor and leaves no status to swallow.
3. The catalogue reads at `:546` and `:193` read their status and fail by name, through `if ! x="$(...)"`, never a bare assignment, which would end doctor.
4. `upgrade` over a manifest with no entries is the same class as 0146; it refuses as it does over a missing manifest, unless forced.

## Done when

1. A header-only manifest fails doctor by name, and the output no longer says "vendored files intact"; red at 2ce9411.
2. A header-only manifest makes `upgrade` refuse without `--force`, naming why; red at 2ce9411.
3. A reader failure planted in a fixture's vendored catalogue makes doctor's shadowing check fail by name.
4. A scan refuses `|| true` after a count or a catalogue accessor in `lib/cmd/doctor`.

## Resolution

Fixed at 85f2fb0b. A manifest that records no files vouches for none, and every reader that refuses or fails a missing manifest now asks `manifest_unvouched`, which answers `missing` or `empty`, and says which it found. doctor fails it by name and never counts its files intact or unowned; upgrade refuses it unless forced, and vendor refuses it; an install whose manifest names no version runs `unknown`, never the project's own VERSION. fleet's census keeps such a manifest's header version and commit and says NO FILES in its last-vendored cell, and the sweep names it unswept with upgrade's --force remedy and its own count. doctor counts through `nonempty_lines`, which has no status to lose, and its catalogue reads fail by name.

Against the done-when list:

1. A header-only manifest fails doctor by name, and the output no longer says "vendored files intact": doctor.bats's arm, red on the code beneath this change.
2. A header-only manifest makes `upgrade` refuse without `--force`, naming why, and the edit under it survives: install.bats's arm, red on that code. vendor refuses it too, and `upgrade --force` over it never sends the reader to vendor.
3. A reader failure planted in a fixture's vendored catalogue makes doctor's shadowing check fail by name: doctor.bats's catalogue arm, red on that code.
4. A contract scan refuses `|| true` after a count or a catalogue accessor in lib/cmd/doctor: contract.bats's arm, red on that code.

Evidence. 26 mutants, all killed, six of them in fleet: five for its readers of a manifest that records no files, and one for the sweep over a manifest it cannot read. The arms run green under GNU coreutils, findutils and sed as well as the BSD tools. cc's full suite, on the stack 0153, 0175, 0159, 0157, 0158 and 0156, which carries this change: 2135 of 2135 ok, 0 not ok, its .errors empty (seal 20261005-1657). The full suite on the landing tree: on main 2efbc7f5 with this change, in a fresh no-local clone, 2140 of 2140 ok, 0 not ok, its .errors empty (seal 20261005-1657), 16:57:23Z to 17:41:06Z, with the same five expected skips; every landed blob equals the suited tree's.
